author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon trailer for a peek at one of the cases coming to the supernatural point-and-click series. The case involves werewolves and, most terrifying of all, traffic. The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon will be available on PC in 2027. A demo is out now.
title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon - Official Case Reveal Trailer | Akupara Direct

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Kumitantei: Old School Slaughter trailer for a peek at what's coming in Episode 2 of the murder-mystery ADV. Episode 2: Gloomy Shojo Sunday of Kumitantei: Old School Slaughter will be available in November 2026 on PC.

Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.
title: Kumitantei: Old School Slaughter - Official Episode 2 Release Date Trailer | Akupara Direct

author: GameTrailers
description: Bonespire is a whimsical-dark crafting simulation game where you forge ancient artifacts, brew dubious potions, and decipher ancient scrolls atop your own wizard tower. Recurring visitors arrive to trade, and your choices ripple out to reshape the world below—all seen from your tower window. Watch the Bonespire announcement trailer to see what you can expect from this game from the creators of Crytpmaster. Bonespire will be available on PC.
title: Bonespire - Official Announcement Trailer | Akupara Direct

author: GameTrailers
description:
Airframe Ultra gets a new trailer gameplay, combat racing, and a release date. Check out the Airframe Ultra release date trailer for this retro combat racer from Videocult (creators of Rain World). In Airframe Ultra, make your racer, hop on your airframe (hoverbike), and fight your way through the streets of Megacity West with pipes, chains, katanas, and whatever else you can get your hands on. Online multiplayer racing is only half of it...you can get knocked off your bike, brawl on foot, and steal your friend's ride!

Airframe Ultra will be available on PC (via Epic Games Store, Steam, and GOG) on November 5, 2026.
title: Airframe Ultra - Official Release Date Trailer | Akupara Direct

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at AOKAKI in this trailer for the upcoming retro, feudal platformer game full of insect-inspired characters. In AOKAKI, you will dash, pogo, and parry your way across a war-torn land to reclaim it from the clutches of the shogun. The trailer showcases its world, and gives a peek at combat and story. AOKAKI will be available on PC in 2027.
title: AOKAKI - Official Announcement Trailer | Akupara Direct

author: GameTrailers
description: Working with Montabi is a free desktop companion from Mankibo, the team behind Montabi. Place items around your room to attract different Montabi, then watch them visit, idle around your desktop, and stick around for a gentle pat. Discover what draws each one out, uncover rare Legendary Montabi, and complete your Montapedia as you go. Your avatar sits alongside it all, typing away whenever you do. Built-in productivity tools include a to-do list, a Pomodoro timer, and a lo-fi music player, plus gentle affirmations throughout your day. Check out the Working with Montabi announcement trailer to see what to expect ahead of the game's launch on PC and Mac in November 2026.
title: Montabi: Working with Montabi - Official Announcement Trailer | Akupara Direct

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Rain World: Anthology Edition trailer for this upcoming definitive physical release of the survival platformer game from Videocult. The Anthology Edition of Rain World packages the base game with both Downpour and The Watcher expansions. Rain World: Anthology Edition will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Rain World: Anthology Edition - Official Announcement Trailer | Akupara Direct

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Go! Super Awesome Monkey, a 3D platformer developed by maskedmangamedev. Play as SAM and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer! Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels. Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards! Go! Super Awesome Monkey will be available on PC (Steam) in 2027.
title: Go! Super Awesome Monkey - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for EXAM WATCH!, an upcoming academic career simulation game developed by PRC Games. In EXAM WATCH!, players supervise exams, detect different cheating methods, evaluate papers, and make decisions that shape their career and reputation. EXAM WATCH! is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: EXAM WATCH! - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Light Bowgun Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Light Bowgun and breaks down its Boosted Action, featuring run & gun, gunslinging counters, and a storm of bullets! Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance - Official Light Bowgun Boosted Action Trailer
